claims.claim: OpenAI officially published 722 AI-generated mathematical research manuscripts on public GitHub repository (openai/math), organized into 372 distinct families of results.
claims.notes: Covers number theory, algebraic geometry, theoretical computer science, and mathematical physics.

claims.claim: The release includes computer-verified Lean code formalizations for many manuscripts, allowing mathematical kernels to independently verify proofs.
claims.notes: Consulted with Institute for Advanced Study mathematics advisory group.

claims.claim: OpenAI stated each result required roughly 3 hours of frontier model reasoning compute, prompting CEO Sam Altman to declare the dawn of a new era of scientific discovery.

editorial_cautions: Note that manuscripts are in varying stages of peer review and formal Lean check.
Highlight the immense volume: 722 manuscripts across 372 mathematical families.
